prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one redesigned symbol for the Korean reading service Bookjeok. Image 1 is the EXISTING brand identity reference: a standing closed book with one large leaf in front; preserve only this subject, not its literal drawing. Images 2-3 are Henri Matisse drawing STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, do not reproduce any human face, artwork, poster or text. Radically reinterpret the book-and-leaf in the economical, assured, irregular black ink contour language of Matisse's line portraits. A human artist's broad reed pen, freely varying width, tapered ends, 4-6 deliberate sweeping contours, honest asymmetry, bold intervals and open negative space. The book should still read as a standing book with a curved bound spine and one simple top page slit, but eliminate detailed page hatching. The leaf should be one lively abbreviated charcoal contour with a single muted dark moss green dab on the leaf tip, only about 8 percent of colored ink area. No elaborate leaf veins. One mark centered, occupies 75 percent of square canvas, truly transparent background. Flat near-black #262823 and discreet muted moss #596551 only. IMPORTANT visual quality: radically different from the old detailed botanical brush logo, still recognizable as book and leaf; restrained literary atelier mark, not generic eco wellness icon. No gradient, shadow, 3D, glow, faux distressed speckles, watercolor washes, ornament, circles, sparkles, symmetry, photoreal paper, people, typography or watermark. A crisp intentional silhouette that can read at 30px.

Use case: logo-brand. Create one new symbol, radically redesigning the book-and-leaf logo for Korean reading service Bookjeok. Image 1 is its EXISTING subject reference, a standing bound book with leaf in front. Image 2 is a Henri Matisse cut-paper STYLE reference only; no dancer, star, poster, lettering or copied composition. Use Matisse's late gouache paper-cut economy: tactile-looking hand-scissored asymmetric contours, flat organic masses, one black book silhouette and a small muted moss green leaf inserted like a cutout. Make the standing book form fluid, chunky and alive rather than rectangular clipart; a cream-free TRANSPARENT slit at the top implies the page block, another decisive cut implies spine; two or three pieces maximum. The leaf is a single small pointed, gently bent green paper form, not a sprout with multiple leaves, with one transparent vein slit at most. Strong charcoal area about 88 percent of colored ink area, very subtle dark desaturated moss #596551 about 12 percent. Palette near-black #252722 + moss only, true transparent background, no white paper backdrop or cream-filled page block. Mark occupies 75 percent of square frame. Deliberate asymmetry and irregular contour, poetic literary publisher quality, distinctive cut-paper logo, easy to recognize at 30px. Avoid generic open-book-with-sprout branding, symmetry, rounded app-icon box, letters, badges, texture noise, faux grunge, illustration shading, gradients, shadows, 3D and excessive botanical veins. Just one symbol, no presentation board or text.
